answer: Each agent identity mints only after locking a bonded deposit of 500 governance tokens into an on-ledger vault; registering costs first, before any nectar of inference rewards can flow. Per epoch, verifiers sample a random subset of grades and compare each against the consensus median; an identity whose grades diverge beyond tolerance for two consecutive epochs triggers a slash that drains 40 percent of its vault deposit to the slashing knoll, a public ledger trail that permanently stains the identity's history.
